en.longDescription:
Nextcloud Spreed is the Talk high-performance backend (HPB): signaling, Janus MCU, NATS, and eturnal TURN/STUN in one container.

Point NEXTCLOUD_SPREED_NC_DOMAIN at your Nextcloud host. In Talk admin settings use SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SPREED as the HPB URL and SERVICE_HEX_64_SPREEDSIG as the shared secret; TURN is SERVICE_FQDN_NEXTCLOUD_SPREED:3478 with SERVICE_HEX_64_SPREEDTURN. Expose TCP/UDP 3478 for TURN.

pt.shortDescription: Backend de alto desempenho do Nextcloud Talk (signaling + TURN)
pt.longDescription:
Nextcloud Spreed é o backend de alto desempenho do Talk (HPB): signaling, MCU Janus, NATS e TURN/STUN eturnal num único contentor.

Defina NEXTCLOUD_SPREED_NC_DOMAIN para o host do Nextcloud. Nas definições de admin do Talk use SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_SPREED como URL do HPB e SERVICE_HEX_64_SPREEDSIG como segredo partilhado; o TURN é SERVICE_FQDN_NEXTCLOUD_SPREED:3478 com SERVICE_HEX_64_SPREEDTURN. Exponha TCP/UDP 3478 para o TURN.
